questions.question: What should have been (a)/ a great disaster (b)/ was averted.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'could' in place of 'should'. Meaning based error hai ye. 'What should have been a great disaster' ka matlab hoga 'Jo bahut bada Distaster hona chahiye tha'. Aur 'What could have been a great disaster' ka matlab hoga 'Jo bahut bada distaster ho sakta tha'. Toh 'ho sakta tha' waale meaning ke liye 'could' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: You must (a)/ be hurry, (b)/ otherwise you will (c)/ miss the train.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'be'. kyunki 'must' modal ke baad ek hi main verb aayegi 'be' and 'hurry' dono verbs hain. Sentence ka matlab hai 'tumhe jaldi karna chaiye', toh Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'hurry' main verb rahegi, aur 'be' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: There was such a crowd (a)/ that he would (b)/ not find his brother.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'could' in place of 'would'. Meaning based error hai ye. 'he would not find his brother' ka matlab hoga 'wo apne bhai ko nahi dhundega'. Aur 'he could not find his brother' ka matlab hoga 'wo apne bhai ko nahi dhund paaya tha'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'dhund nahi paaya' wala meaning sahi hai, isliye yahan 'could' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Distrust seems to (a)/ be a factor borne out (b)/of prevailing circumstances.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'born' in place of 'borne'. Both 'born' and 'borne' are forms of verb 'bear'. 'Born' is commonly used with the meaning "to give birth." 'Borne' is used in adjective form with the meaning 'being carried by'. eg water borne (paani ke dwara carry kiya jaane wala) air borne (hawa ke dwara carry kiya jaane wala) etc. sentence ka matlab hai 'avishvaas maujooda paristhithi se paida hua ek factor hai', toh sentence mein 'paida' wala meaning chaiye, isliye yahan 'born' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The scooter that (a)/ I am using (b)/ these days is belonging (c)/ to my brother.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'belong' instead of 'is belonging'. Kyunki 'belong' ek stative verb hai, Stative verb esi verbs hoti hain jinhe hum 'ing' form mein use nahi karte. Like -feel, believe, smell, hear, listen, look, belong, have, etc. kyunki 'I' ke according 'belong' sahi hogi.

questions.question: Would you find me (a)/ absent please do not(b)/ forget to leave a message behind.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'should' in place of 'would'. Yeh 'should' word ka ek unique use hai. Generally toh yeh modal hi hota hai par 'should' word conjunction bhi ban sakta hai par iska matlab hota hai 'agar'. Yahan sentence ke meaning ke according 'agar' meaning dena hai isliye 'if' yaa 'should' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The new taxation rates (a)/ announced by the government (b)/ are bound to effect the export sector.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'affect' in place of 'effect'. 'affect' generally ek verb ka work karta hai aur 'effect' noun ka. Infinitive 'to+v1' se banta hai, isliye yahan 'to affect' ayega.

questions.question: He uses to study (a)/ till 11 P.M.(b)/ and then goes before (c)/ the library closes.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'studies' in place of 'uses to study'. poore sentence ko padhke pata chal raha hai ki yahan present ke habitual action ki baat ho rahi hai isliye yahan present indefinite tense lagega jisme verb ki first form use hoti hai. Yahan koi past ki habit nahi hai. Isliye yaha 'studies' present indefinite tense sahi hoga.

questions.question: Every night I am (a)/ in the habit of hearing(b)/ the news on the Radio(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: Use 'listening to' in place of 'hearing'. 'listen' ka matlab hota hai 'intentionally kisi cheez ko sunna'. 'hear' ka matlab hota hai 'koi cheez sunai de jaana'. Toh 'news' generally intentionally he sunte hai, aur 'listen' ke sath 'to' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye 'listening to' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I have friends (a)/ who should love (b)/ to stay at home, (c)/ but they have to go to work.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'would' in place of 'should'. yeh modal ke meaning par based error hai. 'friends who should love to stay at home' ka matlab hoga 'friends jinhe ghar par rehna pasand karna chahiye'. Aur 'friends who would love to stay at home' ka matlab hoga 'friends jo ghar par rehna pasand karenge'. Toh sentence ke according 'pasand karenge' wala meaning chaiye, isliye 'would' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The Desais soon (a)/ got used to live (b)/ in the country.(c)/ no error
questions.solution: Use 'got used to living' in place of 'got used to live'. 'get' yahan linking verb hai aur 'used' yahan adjective hai jo subject complement ka kaam karega, 'get' verb ke liye 'to' preposition hai aur 'live' ko preposition ka object banana hai lekin 'live' toh verb hoti hai, toh verb mein 'ing' lagade toh wo gerund(noun) ban jaayega, isliye yahan 'to living' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The man who (a)/ was committed (b)/ the theft last night (c)/ was caught this evening.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'was'. 'man' commit karne ke action ka doer hai isliye verb active form mein aayegi isliye 'was' ko hatana hoga kyunki 'was + verb' ki 3rd form passive voice hoti hai.

questions.question: Every morning (a)/ he might kiss (b)/ his beloved (c)/ and set off for work.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'used to or would' in place of 'might'. sentence mein 'might' se pata chal raha hai ki past ki baat ho rahi hai. Aur 'every morning' se pata chal raha ki past ki habit hai yeh, toh past ki habit show karne ke liye 'used to' yaa 'would' model ka use karte hai.

questions.question: When the allotted time (a)/was over they torn off (b)/the papers which they had used.(c)/ no error
questions.solution: Use 'tore' in place of 'torn'. 'tear' verb ki form 'tear, tore torn' hoti hai, toh 'tore' verb ki 2nd form hai aur 'torn' 3rd form hai. Yahan 2 past ke actions ki baat ho rahi hai isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form aayegi.

questions.question: Psychology has been (a)/ defined the scientific study of (b)/ human psyche and behaviour.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'defined as the' instead of 'defined the'. kyunki kuch aisi verbs hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use kiya jaata hai. jaise 'define, regard, describe, treat, know etc' kyunki in verbs mein generally aisa meaning banta hai 'kisi ko kisi ke jaisa manna'. Eg. - Kalidasa is known as the Shakespeare of India.

questions.question: The unreasonable behaviour (a)/of his daughter (b)/ was thoroughly (c)/upset Mr.Gupta.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'upset' in place of 'was upset'. kyunki yahan active voice ka use hoga naa ki passive ka. Yahan meaning yeh hai ki 'uski daughter ke unreasonable behaviour ne Mr. Gupta ko poori tarah se upset kar diya'. 'was upset' passive voice hai or voice active karni hai isliye verb ki 2nd form sirf 'upset' use hoga isliye C part se 'was' remove karenge.

questions.question: The child cut his (a)/finger with a razor (b)/and bleeded profusely.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'bled' in place of 'bleeded'. kyunki 'bleed' verb ki forms hoti hai 'bleed, bled, bled'. Sentence ke according 2nd form chaiye, isliye 'bled' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The knight was received (a)/ compliments from the king (b)/for his bravery.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'received' in place of 'was received'. kyunki yahan passive voice nahi active voice ki zarurat hai. Passive mein verb ka object nahi hota, lekin yahan 'compliments' object hai. Isliye isse 'received' active voice mein likhenge.

questions.question: The criminal (a)/will certainly be hung (b)/because the charges brought upon (c)/him are very serious.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'hanged' in place of 'hung'. hang hung hung(latkaana); hang hanged hanged 'faansi dena'.

questions.question: Whatever one may say (a)/ of him, (b)/ none dare call in question (c)/ his honesty. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'dares to call' in place of 'dare call'. Yahan 2 galtiyan hain. Ek yeh ki yahan koi 'not' wala yaa interrogative structure nahi ban raha isliye yahan 'dare' ko 'main verb' manenge, aur jab dare main verb banta toh uske baad infinitive aata hai, isliye iske baad 'call' ko 'to call' infinitive mein change karenge, kyunki 2 verbs ek sath nahi aayengi. Dusri galti yeh ki 'none' ke baad generally singular verb prefer ki jaati hai isliye 'dares' likhenge, isliye 'dares to call' sahi hoga.

questions.question: When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fleed the spot.
options: When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fled the spot.
When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately flew the spot.
When the villagers putted up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fleed the spot.
When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately flown the spot.
questions.solution: use 'fled' instead of 'fleed'. sentence mein 'flee' verb ki baat karni hai jiski form 'Flee, Fled, Fled' hoti hai aur 'when' se pata chal raha ki past ke do action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'fled' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi.

questions.question: When I was young.(a)/ I can run (b)/faster than mohan.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'could' in place of 'can'. sentence padhke pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, toh verb past mein aayegi, isliye 'can' ki past form 'could' sahi hogi.

questions.question: I never considered him to be a person who would (a)/ go back on his promise and (b)/ then do not even apologise.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Remove 'do'. kyunki yahan 2 verbs 'and' conjunction se Jodi gayi hai isliye 2nd verb apologise se pehle bhi 'would' modal understood hai, 'who would go back on his promise and then (would) not even apologise'. Isliye yahan 'do' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
options: As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we were going for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
questions.solution: use 'dug' instead of 'digged'. sentence mein 'dig' verb ki baat karni hai jiski form 'Dig, Dug, Dug' hoti hai, toh sentence mein 'as soon as' se pata chal raha ki do action sath mein ho rahe hai aur 'went' se past ka pata chal raha hai, isliye yahan bhi verb ki 2nd form 'dug' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: A soldier (a)/ could fight (b)/ for his country and save his county's honour.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'must' in place of 'could'. yeh modal verb ke meaning par based error hai. 'A soldier could fight for his country' ka matlab hoga 'ek soldier apne desh ke liye lad sakta hai'. Aur 'A soldier must fight for his country' ka matlab hoga 'ek soldier ko apne desh ke liye zarur ladna chahiye'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according compulsion wala meaning chaiye, isliye yahan 'must' model ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Would you liked (a)/ to have some fries (b)/ along with your coffee, sir?" (c)/ asked the waiter.(d)
questions.solution: use 'like' instead of 'liked'. kyunki modal verbs ke baad verb ki 'base form' ka use kiya jaata hai. Isliye yahan 'like' verb ki base form sahi hogi.

questions.question: "He may live long"(a)/ his sad mother (b)/ prayed.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'May he live long' in place of 'He may live long'. kyunki yeh ek optative sentence hai jo ki prayer ke liye use hua hai. Optative sentence wo hote hai jo prayer, wish, desire etc. ko express karte hai. Eg. 'long live the king, god bless you, may you live long' etc. Note:- yahan 'may' ki jagah 'might' nahi hoga kyunki yeh direct speech mein likha gaya hai.

questions.question: Raman putted the vegetables (a)/ in the frying pan (b)/ and after adding some water, (c)/ closed the lid.(d)
questions.solution: use 'put' instead of 'putted'. sentence mein 'put' verb ki baat karni hai iski teeno forms same hoti hai, isliye yahan 'putted' ki jagah 'put' ayega.

questions.question: If you get good marks (a)/ I shall happy (b)/as much as you.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'shall be happy' in place of 'shall happy'. kyunki 'shall' ek modal hai aur 'happy' ek adjective hai toh hume 'shall' ke baad ek aise main verb ki zarurat hai jiske baad akela adjective 'happy' aa sake isliye yahan main verb ke roop me ek linking verb 'be' ka use hoga.

questions.question: When the villagers (a)/ were attacked, (b)/ they were raised to violence.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'roused' in place of 'raised'. 'Raise' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi cheez ko uthana', aur 'Rouse' ka matlab 'kisi person ke andar kisi feeling ko jagana'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'villager ke andar violence ki feeling uthpann ho gayi', isliye yahan 'roused' verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: All those students who are participating in the play (a)/ have been notify (b)/ to stay back for rehearsal (c)/ after 3:00 p.m.(d)
questions.solution: use 'have been notified' instead of 'have been notify'. kyunki 'students' notify action ke receiver hain, matlab wo iss ko notify nahi karenge, balki unhe notify kiya jaayega, isliye verb passive form mein aayegi, isliye 'have been notified' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Why didn't (a)/ you submitted (b)/ your project (c)/ on time?(d)
questions.solution: use 'submit' instead of 'submitted'. kyunki 'Do/Does/Did' ke baad verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai, isliye 'didn't you submit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Electric heaters (a)/were providing (b)/to all the officers (c)/at the guest house.(d)
questions.solution: use 'were provided' instead of 'were providing'. kyunki yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Electric heaters' provide kiye gaye the, naa ki 'electric heater kuch provide' karenge, isliye verb passive form mein aayegi 'were provided' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Einstein's school teachers (a)/thought he would (b)/never success (c)/in life.(d)
questions.solution: use 'succeed' instead of 'success'. kyunki 'would' ek modal hai aur modal verbs ke baad verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai, 'Success' ek noun hai aur 'Succeed' verb hai.

questions.question: You need not tell a lie (a)/ when the judge asked you yesterday where you were (b)/ when the crime was committed.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'need not have told a lie' in place of 'need not tell a lie'. kyunki iss sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki 'tumhe jhoot bolne ki zarurat nahi thi, jab judge ne kal tumse pucha tha ki tum kahan the jab crime kiya gaya tha'. Yahan aage past ki baat ho rahi hai matlab wo person jhoot bol chuka hai. Isliye yahan 'modal + have + v3' structure ka use hoga.

questions.question: If we have no definite aim before us (a)/ we would only wonder about in aimless pursuits (b)/ and achieve nothing.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'wander' in place of 'wonder'. 'wander' ka matlab 'bina kisi udeshya yaa disha ke idhar-udhar ghumna'. 'Wonder' ka matlab 'kuch janana chahna, kuch janane ke liye excited hona', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'wander' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The monkeys swinged (a)/ on the branches and (b)/ jumped over the compound wall.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'swung' instead of 'swinged'. 'jumped' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat karna hai, kyunki 'swing' verb ki 2nd and 3rd form 'swung' hoti hai. 'Swing, Swung, Swung', isliye yahan 'swung' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Need you (a)/ to buy (b)/so many books? (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'buy' instead of 'to buy'. Iss sentence ko theek karne ke 2 methods hain. Ek to agar 'need' ko main verb banaye toh 'Do you need to buy' lagake theek ho jaayega aur 2nd agar 'need' ko modal banaye to 'Need you buy' karke theek ho jaayega. 'Correct the latter part' wale concept ke according 'need you buy' wale structure ko prefer krenge.

questions.question: The doctor advised Mr. Murugan that, (a)/ because of his severe cramps, (b)/ he should lay in bed for a few days.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'lie' in place of 'lay'. sentence ka matlab hai 'doctor ne Murugun ko advice kiya, severe cramps ki wazah se unhe kuch din bed pe letna chaiye', toh letne waale meaning ke liye 'lie' verb ka use hoga. 'Lie' verb jiska matlab 'letna yaa pada hona' hota hai aur yeh intransitive hoti hai, iski form 'lie, lay, lain' hoti hai. Aur 'Lay' verb jiska matlab 'letaana yaa rakhna' aur yeh transitive hoti hai, iski form 'lay, laid, laid' hoti hai.

questions.question: Though the police tried all sorts of methods to illicit (a)/ information from the public (b)/ they remained silent.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'elicit' in place of 'illicit'. 'Elicit' ka matlab 'kisi se information, facts wagera nikalwaana' aur 'Illicit' ka matlab 'illegal (Gair kanooni)', toh sentence ka matlab hai 'police ne public se jankari haasil karne ke liye saare tarike apnaaye', toh 'information' nikaalne ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'elicit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I ordered his dismissal (a)/when he flouted (b)/the company rules.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: no error. 'flout' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi baat ko maane se inkaar karna, law yaa rules ka paalan naa karna', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'flouted' ka use yahan sahi hai.

questions.question: News of the calamity (a)/ is reached (b)/ the family members (c)/the next day.(d)
questions.solution: use 'reached' instead of 'is reached'. kyunki yahan meaning yeh hai ki 'calamity ki news family members ke paas agle din pahunchi thi', toh 'news pahuchi' naa ki 'news ko pahuchaya gaya' isliye isse 'is reached' passive voice mein nahi balki 'reached' active voice mein likhenge.

questions.question: Bhagat Singh lie down (a)/ his life (b)/ for his motherland.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'laid down' in place of 'lie down'. 'lie down' ka matlab 'neeche letna' aur 'lay down' ka matlab 'nyochhawar yaa kurbaan kar dena', sentence ka matlab hai 'Bhagat Singh ne apni motherland ke liye jaan nyochaawar kardi', isliye yahan 'lay down' phrasal verb sahi hoga. Note:- 'lay down' phrasal verb ke aur bhi matlab hote hai.

questions.question: The tennis player easy through the (a)/opening set before her opponent and rallied to take the (b)/final two sets for the biggest victory of her young career.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'eased' in place of 'easy'. kyunki 'easy' ek adjective hai and 'eased' verb hai. Hume yahan 'player' subject ke baad verb ki requirement hai. Isliye yahan 'eased' verb sahi hoga.

questions.question: This summer, (a)/I've met down (b)/a lot of (c)/interesting people.(d)
questions.solution: use 'met' instead of 'met down'. kyunki 'meet down' jaisi koi phrasal verb nahi hai. kisi se milne wale meaning ke liye 'meet' verb ka use hota hai jiski form 'meet, met, met' hoti. 'I've' ka matlab 'I have', toh 'have' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai, isliye 'have met' sahi hoga. eg. I met my uncle.

questions.question: I use to going (a)/for a morning walk (b)/when I was (c)/living in Dehradun.(d)
questions.solution: use 'I used to go' instead of 'I use to going'. kyunki past ke kisi Habitual action ko refer karne ke liye 'used to' modal ka use kiya jaata hai, aur modal verb ke sath verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai. Isliye 'I used to go' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You may ask (a)/ someone where the ship (b)/ is bounded for.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'bound' in place of 'bounded'. 'bound for' phrasal verb hoti hai jiska matlab 'kisi jagah ki taraf'. Eg. This bus is bound for Broadway. Aur ek verb hoti hai 'bind' jiska matlab hota hai (rassi se baandhna) aur iski form hoti hai 'bind, bound, bound'. Eg. They bound the prisoner's hands behind his back. Aur ek aur verb hoti hai 'bound' jiska matlab 'bade bade steps leke bhaagna' jiski form 'Bound, bounded, bounded' hoti hai. Sentence ka matlab 'ship kaha jaa raha hai', toh 'jaane waale meaning ke liye' 'bound for' phrasal verb ka use sahi hai.

questions.question: The problems that our(a)/ country has and will face (b)/ are the outcome of the selfishness (c)/of our so called saviours.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'has faced and will face' in place of 'has and will face'. sentence ka matlab hai 'jo problems apni country face karti hui aa rahi hai aur kargi', toh 'has' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai aur 'will' ke baad verb ki base form, isliye yahan main verb ko common nahi liya jaa sakta. Isliye 'has faced and will face' verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: They made her (a)/as the Chairperson (b)/of their bank (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Remove 'as'. kyunki 'as' comparison ko dikhata hai aur yahan 'her' and 'chairperson' ek hi hai toh comparison nahi hoga. Isliye yahan 'as' ka use nahi hoga. Grammatically baat Karein toh 'her' object hai aur 'chairperson' object complement hai.

questions.question: It is be said (a)/ that in 2019 (b)/ the Indian Stock Market will fall (c)/drastically and we can expect that fall very soon.(d)
questions.solution: use 'it is being said' or 'it is said' instead of 'it is be said'. jab koi expected event ke baare mein batana ho aur yeh wala meaning ho ki 'aisa kaha jata hai' yaa 'aisa kaha jaa raha hai', toh iss meaning ke liye phrase 'it is said' ka use hota hai aur agar wo event chal raha hai toh present continous ka passive 'it is being said' ka use hota hai, sentence ke according dono structure possible hai.

questions.question: Most of my friends(a)/ heard the earthquake (b)/ but I was totally unaware of it.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'felt' in place of 'heard'. kyunki earthquake feel kiya jaayega naa ki suna jaayega. Isliye yahan 'heard' ki jagah 'felt' aayega.

questions.question: The President (a)/ overtakes (b)/ in Bangladesh. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'takes over' in place of 'overtakes'. 'take over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez pe control karna', aur 'overtake' ka matlab 'kisi vehicle wagera se aage nikal jana', sentence ka matlab hai 'president ne Bangladesh ka control le liya', isliye yahan 'takes over' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Our equipment gets damage (a)/very often in summer because (b)/there are frequent power cuts.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'damaged' in place of 'damage'. 'get' linking verb ki tarah kaam karti hai aur iske baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, lekin 'damage' yahan verb hai, isliye isse adjective banana ke liye past participle(adjective) 'damaged' mein change karna hoga. Isliye yahan 'gets damaged' sahi hoga. eg. 'He got injured. He got tired'.

questions.question: It was a (a)/windy autumn day (b)/and leaves were fallen (c)/rapidly from the trees.(d)
questions.solution: use 'falling' instead of 'fallen'. kyunki 'fall' happening verb hai iska passive nahi banta aur yahan meaning passive wala nahi dena. Balki yeh kehna hai ki 'wo ek windy autumn day tha jisme jaldi jaldi tree se patte gir rahe the', toh koi cheez ho rahi thi, isliye yahan 'fall' verb ki happening(ing) form 'were falling' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He transferred (a)/the melted iron (b)/in a large container.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'molten' instead of 'melted'. Yahan 'iron' noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hai. Aur 'melt' verb ki form 'Melt, Melted, Melted' hoti hai aur 'molten' ek adjective hota hai, isliye yahan 'molten iron' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He was so curious that he rose many questions in the meeting.
questions.solution: Ye question 'rise, raise and arouse' ke difference pe based hai. 'raise' transitive verb hoti hai jisme matlab 'uthana, badhaana, paalna' hota hai aur 'rise, arise' dono intransitive verb hoti hai, sentence mein transitive verb chaiye kyunki 'questions' object diya hai sentence ka matlab hai 'usne uthaaye bahut saare question meeting mein', toh meaning aur grammar ke according 'raised' verb sahi hogi. 'raise' verb ki forms 'raise, raised, raised' hoti hai.

questions.question: My friend is owing an expensive cell phone.
options: is own an expensive cell phone
questions.solution: 'own' possession ko dikhane wali ek stative verb hoti hai aur iski 'ing form' nahi hoti. Subject singular hai isliye 'owns' singular verb wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Delegates of the conflicting countries formally meet at a conference to ironing out their differences.
questions.solution: yahan 2 concepts use ho rahe hai. Ek toh yeh ki action ka purpose bataane ke liye yaa verb se 'why' ka reply dene ke liye 'to + v1' infinitive ka use hota hai. Dusra concept 'iron out' phrasal verb hoti hai meaning 'problems aur dispute ko niptaana'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'to iron out' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Old people acquire experience through age.
questions.solution: 'experience prapt karna' meaning dene ke liye 'gain experience' ka use hoga. Yeh reading based question hote hain ki kya meaning mein konsi verb ayegi.

questions.question: The application of the medicine seemed to lesson his pain.
questions.solution: yahan infinitive likhna hai jo 'to + v1' se banta hai. 'lesson, lesion' word noun hote hai or 'lessen' ek verb hai or 'lessened' past participle(adjective) hota hai. Toh infinitive ke liye verb ki jarurat hai, isliye 'to lessen' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Eighty girls sat there at four long tables, doing their homework by candlelight.
options: to have done their homework with
questions.solution: yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'eighty girls 4 long tables pe bethkar apna homework karti hui candle light ke side mein', toh continuity dikhaani hai isliye 'doing' present participle ko sahi use kiya gaya hai. Isliye option A galat hoga. C option isliye nahi hoga kyunki yaa toh meaning ke according 'doing' se a sakta hai yaa 'to do' lekin 'to doing' se nahi. D option isliye nahi hoga kyuki usme 'its' likha hai, jabki 'girls' ke liye 'their' chaiye, isliye 'no improvement' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The snowstorm in that region will effect thousand of travellers.
questions.solution: 'Affect' verb hoti hai aur 'Effect' noun hota hai. Sentence mein verb ki jarurat hai, isliye option B aur C galat honge. Option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'would' model hai aur model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye option A bhi galat hoga. 'Hazaro travellers' meaning dene ke liye yahan 'thousands of travellers' ka use hoga. Isliye D option 'will affect thousands' hi sahi hoga.

questions.question: A clinical thermometer consists of a long, narrow, uniform glass tube.
questions.solution: A option isliye nahi hoga kyunki 'consist' ek stative verb hai iski 'ing' form nahi hoti. C option isliye nahi hoga kyunki singular subject ke according singular verb aayegi. D option isliye nahi hoga kyunki yahan ek fact bataya jaa raha jo ki present indefinite tense yani v1 mein likha jata hai. Isliye yeh 'no improvement' hoga.

questions.question: The district woken up to a thick blanket of snow this morning as the winter entered its most bitter phase.
questions.solution: question mein aage 'entered' word se pata chal raha hai ki past tense ayega, 'woken' 3rd form hoti hai, isliye option B galat hoga, 'awaken' jaise koi word nahi hai 'awoken' hota hai, isliye option C bhi galat hoga, past tense ki baat karni hai, isliye sirf D option verb ki 2nd form 'woke up to a' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The small farmers often need at borrow money to meet high expenses.
questions.solution: Generally need verb ke baad infinitive ka structure aata hai. Eg. He needs to study hard. isliye C option 'need to' aayega.

questions.question: Rioting broke out after the government raised the fuel prices again.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'broke' 2nd form se pata chal raha ki sentence past mein hai isliye diye gaye options mein 'raised' verb ki 2nd form he sahi hoga. Isliye 'no subsitution' sahi hoga.

questions.question: As the tree came crashing down, the monkeys woke up from its sleep and ran from branch to branch.
questions.solution: sentence mein 'came' verb se pata chal raha sentence past mein hai aur 'monkeys' plural hain, isliye 'their' ka use hoga. isliye 'woke up from their sleep' A option sahi hoga. 'waken' jaise word nahi hota, 'woken' 3rd form hoti hai.

questions.question: The prospects of surviving any serious illness are improved if the disease is catching early.
questions.solution: sentence ka matlab hai 'kisi bhi serious bimaari se bachne ka prospect bhad jaayega agar uss bemaari ko samay se pakad liya jaaye', toh yahan 'disease' kuch nahi pakdegi, balki disease ko pakadna hai, isliye isse passive voice mein likhenge isliye option D galat hoga. Option A aur C bhi galat honge kyunki yeh continuous mein likhe, sentence mein koi continuity show nahi karni, Toh passive ke according 'is caught earlier' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The range of flavours is determined by where the plant species is grown and how it is processed.
questions.solution: Sentence ka maltab hai 'flower ki range determine hoti hai ki kahan plant ki species grow hui hai aur kaise unhe process kiya gaya hai', toh 'plant' kuch process nhai kar rahe balki unhe 'process' kiya jaa raha hai, isliye yahan passive voice aayega, option A aur B galat honge kyunki active mein likhe hai, sentence mein kahi gayi baat ek fact ke taur pe hai naa ki past ka koi action isliye yahan present indefinite ka passive 'it is processed' he sahi hoga. Option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The news about the surge in Covid-19 cases broadcasted every morning.
questions.solution: Noun chapter ke according 'news' ke sath verb singular aati hai aur 'broadcast' verb ki form 'v1,v2,v3' same hi hoti hai. Isliye 'is broadcast' B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The pilgrims were fined them one thousand rupees each for littering around the shrine.
questions.solution: sentence ka maltab hai 'Pilgrims par fine lgaya gaya' naa ki 'pilgrims ne fine lagaya' ye meaning dene ke liye passive voice ka use hoga, isliye B option nahi hoga. Verb plural chahiye isliye C option nahi hoga. object 'them' nahi aayega isliye A option bhi nahi hoga. D option 'were fined' sahi hai.

questions.question: Hears to the news tonight at 9 p.m., as there will be an important announcement about the budget.
questions.solution: Yeh imperative sentence banana hai isliye v1 ka use hoga aur 'news' ko sunne ke liye 'hear' nahi 'listen' verb ka use hoga isliye D option aayega. 'jab intentionally' sune toh 'listen' aur 'sunai de jaaye', toh 'hear' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: I worked hard so that I might success.
questions.solution: yhan modal ke baad verb ki base form aayegi. success and successor noun hain, successful adjective hai. succeed verb hai. isliye yhan C option aayega.

questions.question: The green shirt is too lose for me to wear.
questions.solution: 'lose' verb ka maltab (harna yaa kho dena), 'loss' noun ka matlab (nuksaan), 'loose' adjective ka matlab (dheela), 'is' linking verb ke baad adjective ki jarurat hai, isliye 'loose' adjective ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: According to J Krishnamurti, education is not about having a career but about being able to look, observation and listen.
questions.solution: yahan 3 infinitives ko joda gaya hai 'to look', 'to observe' and 'to listen'. yeh concept advance verb mein padhaya jata hai ki jab 2 yaa 2 se jada infinitive conjunction se jode jaate hain uss case 'to' bas first infinitive ke sath hi likhte hain. Isliye C option aayega. A mein 'observer' noun hai isliye galat hai. B mein 'observant' adjective hai isliye galat hai. D mein 'observation' noun hai isliye galat hai.

questions.question: The river overflew it's banks in the monsoon.
questions.solution: 'Banks' (river ke kinaare) yeh word noun hai ispe river ka possession banane ke liye 'its' possessive adjective ka use hoga. 'It's = It is' hota hai aur ye pronoun + verb hota hai isliye B option galat hai. 'overflow' verb ki form 'overflow, overflowed, overflowed' hoti hai, isliye option D 'overflwoed its banks' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If somebody attacks you, you needs be able to defend yourself.
questions.solution: 'You' subject ke baad verb plural aati hai aur 'need' verb ke baad generally infinitive se structure banta hai isliye 'need to be able' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The children's cricket ball hit their neighbour's window and it broke.
questions.solution: yahan meaning dena hai 'wo khidki toot gyi' iske liye happening verb 'it broke' sahi lagi hui hai. A option me 'is' ke baad v2 diya hai, B option mein v3 bina helping verb ke hai, C option me continuous hai. isliye ye teeno options galat hai.

questions.question: My student, a doctor by profession, preferring to walk to the hospital everyday.
questions.solution: 'everyday' se pata chal raha ki habitual action hai, aur Habitual action ke liye present indefinite tense yani 'V1' lagate hai aur subject singular hai isliye verb singular ayegi. isliye C option 'prefers to walk' sahi hai.

questions.question: I request you to not to crack jokes in the class.
questions.solution: Kisi ko kuch karne ki request ke liye generally ye structure use hota hai :- 'I request you to help me.' Yahan kuch naa karne ki request hai iske liye 'not + infinitive' ka use hota hai. isliye 'not to crack' A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Shall you pass me that pasta bowl?
questions.solution: yahan 'khane ka bowl' pass karne ki request kari jara hi hai jo ki informal request ke ander ayega, informal request ke liye 'can' model ka use karte hai isliye 'can you pass' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: I told Pooja that she could have use my car to get around while she is in my hometown
options: that she could have use my car to get around with
that she can use my car to get around
that she could have use my car to get away
that she can use my car to get away with
questions.solution: A and C option galat hai kyunki 'modal + have + V3' sahi structure hota hai. D option ke last me 'get away with' dia hai jiska meaning 'punishment se bachke nikal jana hota hai' jo sentence ke meaning ke according sahi nahi hai. B option mein jo 'get around' hai uska meaning hota hai 'bina kisi problem ke alag alag jagahon pe jana', toh isse matlab hoga 'wo meri car use kar sakti hai kahin bhi jaane ke liye jab wo seher mein ho', toh meaning ke according 'to get around' wala option B sahi hoga. Note:- Tense chapter ke concept ke according main clause past mein hai toh sub clause bhi past mein hona chahiye but aisa koi option nahi hai jo grammatically 100% sahi ho toh diye gaye options mein se B best hai usi ko mark karna padega.

questions.question: Would you have been so kind as to close the window?
questions.solution: Polite request ke liye 'would' modal ka use hota hai aur modal ke baad verb base form mein aati hai isliye B option 'would you be' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Do I need finish this work today itself?
questions.solution: 'Need' modal ya main verb banta hai jiske yahan according 2 structures ho sakte the. 'Do I need to finish this work today itself?', aur 'Need I finish this work today itself?'. 1st structure mein need ke baad infinitive chahiye tha jo ki diya nahi hai. isliye B option 'Need I finish' hi mark kiya jaayega.

questions.question: Don't park your car here, the police should tow it away.
questions.solution: yahan possibility show karni hai, generally possibility show karne ke liye 'may' yaa 'might' modal ka use hota hai. Isliye C option 'might' use hoga.

questions.question: My uncle and his family may come late last night, but I am not sure.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'mere uncle aur unki family shayad kal der raat aaye honge.' iss meaning ke liye 'modal + have + V3' ka structure use hota hai. isliye B option 'might have come' ka use hoga.

questions.question: If Sahana works till night she can be able to finish her homework.
questions.solution: 'Can' yaa 'Could' modal ka use jab ability dikhaane ke liye kiya jata hai toh inke baad 'be able to' ka use superfluous ho jata hai matlab unnecessary ho jata hai. Options ke according best answer D hai.

questions.question: Natwar was a fraudster who always tried to fooling others.
questions.solution: Iss question mein verbs ke meanings se confuse na hona. yahan simple concept yeh ki yahan 'try' verb ke baad infinitive likhna hai 'to' bhi likha hai isliye base form 'deceive' lagake 'to deceive' infinitive ban jaayega. Kyunki infinitive mein 'to + v1' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Last week's rain ravaged the whole city.
questions.solution: Yeh question or aage bhi kaafi question mainly verb ke meaning pe based hain. Sentence and verb ke meaning ke according best option select karna hai. 'Ravage' aur 'Ruin' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko bahut buri tarah nuksan pahuchana', 'Rescind' ka matlab 'kisi law wagera ko cancel karn'. 'Retract' ka matlab 'peche hatna yaa promise wagera se mukar jana', toh sahi meaning ke according 'ruined' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Her hopes for building her own house were beaten when she lost her jewellery box.
questions.solution: Yeh verb ke meaning pe based question hai. were defeated - hara di gyi; were frustrated - pareshan kar di gyi; were relieved - free kar di gyi; were dashed - khatam ho gyi. 'Dash someone's hopes' ek idiom hai jiska meaning hota hai 'kisi ki hopes khatam karna'. Isliye meaning ke according D option aayega.

questions.question: In times of difficulty, she preys for an oracle to guide her.
questions.solution: Prey (noun) – shikaar, Pray (verb) – prarthna karna, Praise (verb) – tareef karna, price (noun) - keemat, Isliye grammar and meaning ke base pe yahan D option 'prays' aayega kyunki Subject singular hai.

questions.question: The government has finally agreed to wave the entertainment tax on the movie.
questions.solution: wave (verb) – haath hilana, wave (noun) - samundar ki leher, waive (verb) - apna haq yaa claim tyaag dena, Wager (verb) - to bet or gamble, Waiver (noun) - a document that records the fact that someone has given up the right to a claim, isliye meaning and grammar ke according yahan A option 'waive' aayega.

questions.question: Polyethylene terephthalate, one of the most often recycled plastics and the material used in the majority of water and soda bottles, can be transformed into everything from polyester fabric to automotive parts.
questions.solution: 'might be placed' ka matlab 'rakha jaa sakta hai', 'might be evolved' ka matlab 'evolution kiya jaa sakta hai', 'may be converted' ka matlab 'ek form se dusre form change kiya jaa sakta hai', 'may be devaluated' ka matlab 'value ko kam kiya jaa sakta hai', Isliye yahan sentence ke meaning ke according 'may be converted' C option sahi hoga.

questions.question: The commanders entered by force into terrorists' camp.
questions.solution: 'Broke into' ka matlab 'kisi jagah bina permission ke ghusna', 'Broke down' ka matlab 'kaam karna band kar dena', 'Broke with' ka matlab 'kisi riste yaa sambhand ko khatam karna', 'Broke off' ka matlab 'kisi cheez band karna yaa samaapt karna', sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'broke into' phrasal verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: Pintu has been advised to reduce smoking by his family doctor.
questions.solution: A, B and C options grammatically sahi nahi hai. Meaning and grammar ke according D option sahi hai. 'Cut down' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ke aakar, maatra yaa sankhya ko kam karna'.

questions.question: The question was raised for discussion before the members during the assembly session.
questions.solution: 'came up' ka matlab 'jiske baare mein baat kari jaani hai', 'came off' ka matlab 'ghatith hona, safal hona', 'came round' ka matlab 'kisi ki salaah manana', 'came out' ka matlab 'publish hona, ujaagar hona'. Meaning ke according yahan 'came up' phrasal verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: His disease is no doubt very serious but he will pull over.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ye dena hai ki :- 'uski bimari serious hai lekin wo survive kar jaayega' iss meaning ke liye 'pull through' phrasal verb ka use hota hai. 'Pull through' ka matlab 'kisi khatarnak yaa kathin daur se bach likhna'. Isliye option A sahi hoga. Eg :- She had pneumonia but she pulled through.

questions.question: When I was your age, I was working two jobs to provide for my family.
questions.solution: No substitution. Verb yani action ka purpose batane ke liye yaa keh sakte hain verb se 'why' ka reply dene ke liye generally Infinitive ka use hota hai. aur 'provide for' phrasal verb ka meaning hota hai :- 'kisi ko uski jarurat ki cheez dena'. isliye question mein 'to provide for' sahi use hua hai. Isliye option D 'no subsitution' sahi hoga. Note:- Infinitive and gerunds phrasal verb se bhi banaye jaate hain.

questions.question: You must cut off your expenses if you want to save money.
questions.solution: 'cut out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ka bina kaam ka hissa hatana', 'cut down on' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko kam karna', 'cut for' jaisi koi phrasal verb nahi hai, 'cut up' ka matlab 'bahut buri tarah se ghaayal karna' isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'cut down on' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Oscar is the most prestigious award which is introduced to good actors in that year.
questions.solution: 'Award' dene ke liye 'awarded' verb ka use hoga aur oscar obviously best actors ko hi milta hai, isliye 'awarded to best' C option sahi hoga.

questions.question: I am working hard in order to earn a decent living.
questions.solution: No substitution. 'in order to' ke baad verb ki base form ayegi isliye A and B option galat honge. option C meaning ke according sahi nahi hai. D option 'earn a decent living' ka meaning hai 'earn enough money to live a good life' isliye meaning and grammar ke according D option hi sahi hai.

questions.question: Many companies displaced playing income tax last year.
questions.solution: A and C option mein 'Hedge' ka matlab 'kisi question ka seedha jawab dene se bachan' jo ki sentence mein required meaning ke according galat hai. Option B mein 'Circumvent' ka meaning hota hai- 'kisi cheez ko avoid karna' lekin iske baad 'to' preposition ka use galat hai, D option me 'evade paying' ka matlab hai 'pay karne se bachna'. D option grammar and meaning dono ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: You must aware of friends who speak against you.
questions.solution: 'must' ek modal hai iske baad main verb ayegi. 'Caution' noun hai, 'scarce and careful' Adjective hain, isliye A, C, D options galat hain. B option mein 'beware' ek verb hai jo grammar and meaning ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: The child felt down from a great height.
questions.solution: A and D options galat hai kyunki 'V3' and 'v1 + ing' form of verb bina helping verb ke use nahi hoti. B isliye galat hai kyunki 'child' singular hai aur iske baad 'fall' plural verb nahi aa sakti. C option 'fell down' grammatically sahi hai.

questions.question: The little boy did many mischiefs in school.
questions.solution: 'mischief' generally uncountable noun hota hai iska plural nahi hota aur iske sath 'many' nahi aa sakta, isliye A, C, D options galat hain. B option grammatically sahi hai. Note- 'Make a mistake / make mischief'. inn structures mein 'make' verb ka hi use hota hai. ye reading se pata chalta hai.

questions.question: He felt as defenceless as the sheared lamb shievering in the field, stripped of the only protection he had ever had.
questions.solution: Yahan sheared ki jagah shorn hoga kyunki shear ki forms sheared sheared hoti hai lekin iski past participle (adjective) form shorn hoti hai.

questions.question: I was forbidden to take any drink.
questions.solution: 'prohibited from' ka matlab 'avoid karna yaa jaane se rokna' aur 'rebuff, Reject, snub' inn sab verb ka meaning 'ignore karna yaa avoid karna hota hai' isliye yeh verb 'prohibit ke sath' galat hai. B option 'prohibited from receiving' meaning ke according sahi hai. Jisse matlab hoga 'mujhe mana kiya gaya hai koi bhi drink lene se'.

questions.question: She does not helping to getting angry when she sees someone being treated unfairly.
options: is not help to being getting angry
may not help to got angry
will not help to gets angry
questions.solution: yahan sentence ka meaning ye dena hai ki :- wo khud ko rok nahi paati gussa hone se jab wo kisi ko unfairly treat hote hue dekhti hai'. Ye khud ko rok naa pana wala meaning dene ke liye 'can/could not help + gerund' structure ka use hota hai. eg. I could not help crying when I saw his body. question mein aisa hi meaning dena tha isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: We might as well watch a film on TV as there's nothing much to do.
questions.solution: No improvement required. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Hum tv pe ek film bhi dekh sakte hai kyunki or jada kuch karne ke liye hai nahi. yahan'. 'as well' yahan koi simile etc nahi hai ye ek adverb hai jiska meaning 'also jaisa hota hai' isliye yahan grammar and meaning ke according yahan 'We might as well watch..' already sahi use kiya gaya tha.

questions.question: Juliet is telling to Ben to complete the work immediately.
questions.solution: 'Inform, ask and tell' inn verbs ke baad human being direct likha jata hai bina 'to' preposition ke aur 'say' verb ke sath 'to' lagana padta hai agar human being likhna ho toh. Inn reasons ki wajah se option B, C and D galat hai. A option 'is telling Ben' sahi hai.

questions.question: He described about the scenery yesterday.
questions.solution: A and C option galat hain kyunki 'describe' transitive verb hai isliye iske or object ke beech mein preposition nahi ayegi. D isliye nahi aayega kyunki verb plural likhi hai aur waise bhi sentence ke last mein yesterday likha hai isliye past tense verb ki 2nd form ka use hoga, isliye B option 'described the scenery' sahi hai.

questions.question: The workers' union has threatened for going to an indefinite strike.
questions.solution: kuch karne ki dhamki dene wale meaning mein 'threaten' verb ke baad infinitive lagaya jata hai isliye D option 'threatened to go on an indefinite strike' sahi hai.

questions.question: You will be in trouble if you don't obey to my orders.
questions.solution: 'Do/does/did' helping verb ke baad main verb humesha base form mein aati hai isliye C option galat hai. 'Obey' transitive verb hai iske or object ke beech mein preposition nahi ayegi isliye option A and B bhi galat hai. D option 'don't obey my orders' sahi hai.

questions.question: A man in need pleaded for help.
questions.solution: No improvement. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'musibat mein pade admi ne madad ke liye gujarish ki' isliye iss meaning ke according 'pleaded for help' already sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: My friend did not understand the story. She asked me for explain it her.
options: can I explain that to her
questions.solution: kisi ko koi cheez explain karne ke liye 'explain something to somebody' structure ka use hota hai. Isliye A option 'She asked me to explain it to her' sahi hai. Note:- D option isliye galat hai kyunki indirect speech mein interrogative structure use nahi hota. agar D option 'If I could explain it to her' hota to theek ho sakta tha.

questions.question: You can always dependent on me.
questions.solution: 'can' modal ke baad verb ki base form ayegi aur 'depend' ke sath 'on' preposition aati hai. 'depend on somebody' ka matlab 'kisi pe nirbhar hona, rely karna', isliye 'depend on me' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The mob drove on the rampage and looted several shops in the locality.
questions.solution: Yahan 'Go on a rampage' use hoga kyuki ye ek fix phrase hai jiska meaning hota hai :- 'hinsak ho jana yaa hinsab behave karna, jisse nuksan yaa vinaash ho', 'go' ki 2nd form 'went' hoti hai, aur meaning ke according option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The flames of the fire leap into the air.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ke according past indefinite tense aayega naa ki present indefinite isliye option A and B galat hain. 'V1 + ing' bina helping verb ke nahi aata isliye D option galat hai. isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option 'leapt into' sahi hai.

questions.question: On winter evenings, a haze of smog hang in Delhi.
questions.solution: yahan ek fact bataya jaa raha isliye present indefinite tense lagega, isliye A option galat hai. Yahan singular verb ki requirement hai, isliye D option galat hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'delhi ke upar haze of smog hota hai' iss meaning ke liye B option 'hangs over' sahi hai.

questions.question: The walls of the temple caved out due to weak construction.
questions.solution: yahan meaning dena hai ki walls collapse kar gayi matlab gir gyi. Jiske liye 'cave in' phrasal verb ka use hota hai. 'cave in' ka matlab If a ceiling, roof, or other structure caves in, it breaks and falls into the space below. Isliye 'cave in' phrasal verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: Despite not getting approval from the leader, we decided to carry out the plan.
questions.solution: No improvement. 'carry over' ka matlab 'baad mein kisi cheez ka upyog karna', 'carry away' ka matlab 'control khona', 'carry off' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko jabardasti hatana', 'carry out' ka matlab 'koi task perform karna', isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'carry out' aayega.

questions.question: One of the baby elephants broke off from the herd and lost its way.
questions.solution: 'Break off' ka matlab 'relationship wagera khatam karna'. 'Break in' yeh ek noun hota hai iska matlab 'kisi building wagera mein jabardasti ghusna kuch churaane ke liye', 'Break down' ka matlab 'koi machine yaa gaadi wagera kaam karna band kar dene ke liye use hota hai'. 'Break away' ka matlab 'group se alag ho jana'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option aayega.

questions.question: Please fill away this application form while you wait for your turn.
questions.solution: 'Fill out' ka matlab 'koi official document yaa form bharne ke liye jaankari jodna'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'fill out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Drink a mixture of wormwood oil and olive oil to got rid of worms.
questions.solution: infinitive mein 'to + v1' ka use hota hai. isliye option A and C galat hain. Phrasal verb 'Get rid of' ka matlab 'kisi cheez se chhutkara pana yaa fek dena'. isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'to get rid of' aayega.

questions.question: When it comes to love of sports, he takes off his father.
questions.solution: 'Take after' ka matlab 'to resemble a relative' (dikhne mein yaa kisi quality mein apne kisi relative jaisa hona). 'Take off' ka matlab 'to remove clothes etc, to leave the ground (plane) / depart', Isliye yahan meaning ke according C option 'takes after' aayega.

questions.question: My sincerity and patience drove me through all odds and problems of life
questions.solution: 'carried someone through something' ka matlab 'kisi ki madad karna khaaskar muskil waqt mein', Isliye yahan meaning ke according A option ka use hoga.

questions.question: The affection of her husband carried her up in the midst of all her problems.
questions.solution: 'tore someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ko dukh pahuchana', 'bore someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ko emotional dukh sehne mein madad karna', 'stood someone up' ka matlab 'jaanboojh kar kisi se milne mein asafal hona', 'drove someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ki chidaana, gussa yaa pagal kar dena'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan 'bore her up' option B ka use hoga.

questions.question: I was carried by her rapturous song.
questions.solution: 'carry off' ka matlab 'kisi tough kaam ko karne yaa haasil karne mein safal hona'. 'be/ get + carried away' ka matlab 'bahut excited ho jana aur emotional hoke control kho dena'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'carried away' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The Ukranian soldiers passed in for several weeks.
questions.solution: 'Held out' means 'kisi khatarnaak yaa kathin paristhithi mein bane rehna'. Isliye meaning ke according C option 'held out' ka use hoga. Note:- D option mein likhe 'hanged in' ko 'hang in' samaj ke confuse na hon.

questions.question: I called of an explanation for his rude behaviour.
questions.solution: 'called out' ka matlab 'kisi emergency se nipatne yaa koi seva pradaan karne ke liye bulana', 'Call off' ka matlab 'meeting wagera cancel karna', 'Call in' ka matlab 'kisi ko bulana', 'Call into question' ka matlab 'doubtful hona'. Isliye meaning ke according A option 'call out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The NCERT was set up ahead by the government to assist and advise the Central and State Governments on policies and programmes for qualitative improvement in school education.
questions.solution: 'Set off' ka matlab 'koi journey start karna'. 'set forth/forward' ka matlab 'kisi baat ko likhke yaa bolke usse explain karna', 'Set over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko ek person se dusre person tak transfer karna'. 'Set up' ka matlab 'koi business, institution yaa organization sthaapit karna'. isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'set up' aayega.

questions.question: It is a bad habit to talk in while someone is speaking.
questions.solution: 'cut in' ka matlab 'kisi ki baat ko beech mein rokkar khud bolna', 'intrude over' ka matlab 'kisi aise jagah jaana jahan aapka welcome nahi hota', 'burst in' ka matlab 'kisi jagah chillate hue enter karna', 'walk over' ka matlab 'kisi vyakti ki isthithi naa samajhakar uske sath bura vyvhar karna'. Isliye meaning ke according A option 'cut in' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Vishnu and family are looking around into the possibility of moving to Canada.
questions.solution: 'Look around' ka matlab 'kisi jagah pe jaake yeh dekhna ki wahan kya hai', 'Look into' ka matlab 'investigate karna'. 'Look upto' ka matlab 'kisi ki tareef karna, respect karna'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan C option 'are looking into' aayega. Note:- yhan continuous tense lagega naki present indefinite kyu ki ye koi habitual action nahi hai isliye B option galat hai.

questions.question: It was apparent that the girl was heading into a serious disaster.
questions.solution: 'head for' ka matlab 'kisi jagah yaa situation ki taraf badhna', 'head out' ka matlab 'jagah chhodna', 'head down' ka matlab 'value kam hona'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'heading for' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The delegates talked of the matter for an hour but without any result.
questions.solution: 'Talk over' ka matlab 'kisi samjhote pe pahuchne ke liye matter pe discussion karna' isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'talked over' use hoga.

questions.question: The organization had set up for a Free Mandela Committee and launched a lively campaign with the slogan "Free Mandela'
questions.solution: 'Set up' ka matlab 'koi business, institution yaa organization sthaapit karna', 'Set to' ka matlab 'kisi kaam ko determination se shuru karna', 'Set over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko kisi dusri cheez ke upar rakhna yaa tikaana', 'Set upon' ka matlab 'kisi pe hamla karna'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'set up' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The minor project put forward by the government is now moving around into its third year.
questions.solution: yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'project apne third year mein jaa raha hai' iss meaning ke liye A option 'is moving into' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I cannot sit up with this sort of insult in office.
questions.solution: Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'mai iss type ki insult bardasht nahi kar sakta' iss meaning ke liye B option 'put up with' ka use hoga. 'Put up with' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko sehen karna yaa bardaasth karna'.

questions.question: Though Mr.Swami ran in debt, he did not stop wasting money.
questions.solution: 'Run into' ka matlab 'kathinaayi kaa saamna karna, takraa jana', 'Run over' ka matlab 'kisi ko vehicle se kuchal dena', Isliye yeh meaning ke according B option 'run into' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I have been wondering at taking skating as a hobby
questions.solution: 'Wonder' ke sath generally 'about' preposition aatihai. 'Take to' ka matlab 'kisi cheez yaa kisi vyakti ko pasand karna', 'Take up' ka matlab 'koi particular activity shuru karna'. Isliye grammar and meaning ke according B option 'about taking up' use hoga.

questions.question: I can't make out my mind about taking a vacation in winter.
questions.solution: 'Make up one's mind' ka matlab 'kisi baat pe decision lena, mood bana lena', 'Make out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko understand krna', 'Make on' ka matlab 'chalu karna, yaa jalaana', Isliye yahan meaning ke according 'make up' A option aayega.

questions.question: It is quite difficult to make on what this doctor writes.
questions.solution: 'Make out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko understand krna', 'Make on' ka matlab 'chalu karna, yaa jalaana', Isliye yahan meaning ke according 'make out' A option aayega.

questions.question: He felt dejected but the feeling passed out in a minute.
questions.solution: 'Pass out' ka matlab 'behosh ho jaana', 'Passed off' ka matlab 'If an event etc passed off' matlab 'wo ek special tarike se ghatith hua aur complete hua'. 'Pass back' ka matlab 'kisi ko apne hath se kuch lautaana', 'Pass on' ka matlab 'mar jaana'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'passed off' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The strong wind blow off all the candles.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ke according past indefinite lagega naaki present indefinite kyunki yeh koi habitual action nahi hai isliye A and C options galat hain. D option isliye galat hai kyunki 'v1+ ing form' bina helping verb ke nahi aati. 'Blow out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko bhujaa dena'. Isliye meaning and grammar ke according B option 'blew out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He got away from punishment as there was not enough evidence against him.
questions.solution: Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan past indefinite tense use hoga isliye A and C option galat hai. 'Get away from' ka matlab 'kisi jagah se bhaag jaana, arrest hone se bachne ke liye', Isliye grammar and meaning ke according question me diya 'get away from' already sahi likha hai. isliye 'no substitution hoga'.

questions.question: I am trying my best to give in junk food.
questions.solution: 'Give in' ka matlab 'surrender hona, sehmat hona', 'Give up' ka matlab 'kuch karna band karna, surrender karna', 'Give out' ka matlab 'baatna, distribute karna', 'Give back' ka matlab 'jiski cheez usko wapas lautaana', Isliye meaning ke according yahan C option 'give up' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I cannot put with his rudeness any longer.
questions.solution: 'Put up with' ka matlab 'sehen karna', 'Put up' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ka nirmaan karna', 'Put away' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko uske sahi place pe lautaana', 'Put up to' ka matlab 'kisi ko galat kaam ke liye raazi karna', Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'put up with' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He fell over in studies owing to his illness
questions.solution: 'fall behind' ka matlab 'peeche reh jaana, yaa samay pe koi kaam naa kar pana', 'Fall over' ka matlab 'kisi insaan balance khokar gir jaaye', 'Fall out' ka matlab 'kisi se behes karna yaa dosti tod dena', 'Fall for' ka matlab 'pyar karne lagna, attract hona'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'fell behind' ka use hoga.

questions.question: After the old building was pulled out, the building contractor surveyed the progress of the work.
questions.solution: 'Pull over' ka matlab 'vehicle side mein lagwana', 'Pull up' ka matlab 'vehicle wagera rokna', 'Pull down' ka matlab 'building wagera gira dena', 'Pull out' ka matlab 'kisi vehicle yaa uske driver ka road ke kinaare se door hat jaana', Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'was pulled down' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Our new accountant fall short in my expectations.
questions.solution: yahan singular verb ki requirement hai isliye A and C options galat hai. 'Fall short of' ka matlab 'expectation poori naa kar pana', Isliye grammar and meaning ke according 'fall short of' B option ka use hoga.

questions.question: His uncle advised Naveen to Keep away from involving himself in the controversy.
questions.solution: No improvement. Kisi ko kuch karne ke liye advise karne ke liye 'advise somebody to do something' iss structure ka use hotahai. 'Keep away (from somebody / something)' ka matlab 'pass jaana yaa shaamil hone se bachna'.

questions.question: The authorities are looked on the matter.
questions.solution: Authorities iss action ki doer hai isliye yahan active voice lagegi. isliye A and B option jo passive mein likhe wo galat hai. 'look into' ka matlab 'investigate karna' isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option ka use hoga.

questions.question: The Soldiers carried around the order of their commander without question.
questions.solution: 'Carry out' ka matlab 'task perform karna', 'be/ get + carried away' ka matlab 'excited ho jaana aur emotionally hokar control kho dena'. isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'carry out' aayega.

questions.question: Before the main concert began, (a)/ the singer sung (b)/ a couple of old folk songs to warm up the crowd. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'sung' with 'sang'. Sentence mein 'sung' ki jagah 'sang' aayega kyunki 'sing' verb ki form 'sing, sang, sung' hoti hai, toh 'sung' 3rd form bina helping verb ke galat hai, sentence mein pata chal raha ki past ki baat karni hai, isliye verb ki 2nd form 'sang' sahi hoga. baaki yahan 'had sung' past perfect tense bhi aata hai, kyunki past perfect tense ka use past ke do action mein comparison ke liye hota hai, jo action pehle hota hai, usse past perfect mein likhte hai, isliye yahan 'had sung' bhi aa sakta hai. lekin 'sang' v2 prefer hoga.

questions.question: The unexpected decision by the principal (a)/ was surprised (b)/ all the students and the teachers present at the event. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'was surprised' with 'surprised'. Sentence mein 'was surprised' ki jagah 'surprised' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'unexpected decision ne surprise kiya' naa ki 'decision surprise hua', isliye isse 'was surprised' passive form mein galat hoga, 'decision ne surprise kiya' waale meaning ke liye verb ko active mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'surprised' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The entire cost of the wedding celebration (a)/ was born (b)/ by the bride's parents. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'born' with 'borne'. 'born' ki jagah 'borne' aayega kyunki 'born' ka matlab 'paida hona', aur 'bear' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ki jimmedari lena, sehna', jiski form 'bear, born, borne' hoti hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'wedding ki poori cost ki jimmedari dulhan ke parents ne li', isliye yahan 'was borne' sahi hoga. kyunki 'is/am/are/was/were' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai. Note:- 'borne' adjective(past participle) bhi banta hai jaise 'water-borne disease' matlab wo bemaari jo 'paani se hoti hai' etc.

questions.question: The ancient texts regarded (a)/ the sun the primary source of all life (b)/ and energy on the earth. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: put 'as' after 'the sun'. kuch aisi verbs hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use kiya jaata hai. jaise 'define, regard, describe, treat, know etc' kyunki in verbs mein generally aisa meaning banta hai 'kisi ko kisi ke jaisa manana', isliye 'the sun' ke baad 'as' aayega. jisse matlab hoga 'ancient text mein sun ko all life ka primary source mana gaya hai'.

questions.question: After the exhausting football match, (a)/ the player laid (b)/ on the grass to recover his strength. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'laid' with 'lay'. Sentence mein 'laid' ki jagah 'lay' aayega kyunki ek verb hoti hai 'lie' jiska matlab 'letna yaa pada hona', joki intransitive hoti hai aur iski form 'lie, lay, lain' chalti hai. dusri hoti hai 'lay' jiska matlab 'letaana yaa rakhana', joki transitive hoti hai aur iski form 'lay, laid, laid' chalti hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'exciting match ke baad player grass pe late gaya', toh player khud leta, toh 'letne' waal matlab ke liye 'lie' verb ki 2nd form 'lay' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The speaker's emotional story managed to rouse deep sympathy among the audience, and many were seen wiping their tears as he continued.
options: The speaker's emotional story managed to
rouse deep sympathy among the audience,
and many were seen wiping their tears
questions.solution: replace 'rouse' with 'arouse'. Sentence mein 'rouse' ki jagah 'arouse' aayega kyunki 'rouse' ka matlab 'kisi ko gehri neend se jagana' aur 'arouse' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi ke andar feeling jagana jaise anger, sympathy, love etc', sentence mein 'emotional story' se pata chal raha hai 'feeling jagaayi hai', isliye yahan 'arouse' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Despite repeated reminders from the accounting department, (a)/ the branch manager did not paid (b)/ the quarterly utility bills (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'paid' with 'pay'. 'paid' ki jagah 'pay' aayega kyunki 'do/does/did' ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'pay' ka use hoga.

questions.question: During the sudden inspection conducted by the health ministry, (a)/ a significant number of expired food items (b)/ was finding in the main storage facility of the restaurant. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'was finding' with 'were found'. Sentence mein 'was finding' ki jagah 'were found' aayega kyunki 'food items was finding' se matlab hoga 'food item dhund rahe hai', jabki meaning dena hai 'food item paaye gaye', toh sahi meaning ke liye passive mein likhna padega, isliye yahan 'were found' passive form sahi hoga. 'items' plural hai isliye 'were' plural verb aayi hai.

questions.question: Before the children left for the playground after breakfast, (a)/ their mother instructed them to lie (b)/ all their soiled clothes carefully into the laundry basket. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to lie' with 'to lay'. Sentence men 'lie' ki jagah 'lay' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'unki mother ne kaha ki gande kapde laundary basket mein daalke jaayo', toh 'daalne, rakhne, letaane' wala meaning ke liye 'lay' verb ka use hota hai, aur 'lie' ka matlab 'letna' hota hai, toh meaning ke according 'to lay' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Before the passengers could board the aircraft, (a)/ they had to confirm that their luggage was correctly tagged (b)/ for the flight bounded for Paris. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: replace 'bounded for' with 'bound for'. Sentence mein 'bounded for' ki jagah 'bound for' aayega kyunki 'bounded' ka matlab 'koi cheez chaaro taraf se ghiri hui ho', aur 'bound for' ka matlab 'koi vehicle wagera kisi jagah ki taraf travel kar raha hai', sentence ka matlab hai 'flight paris jaa rahi hai' matlab 'paris ke liye bound hai', isliye yahan 'bound for' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Despite the initial objections from several members of the board, (a)/ they eventually decided to consider her as (b)/ the primary candidate for the prestigious fellowship. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'as'. Kuch verb jaise 'make, choose, elect, select, anoint, appoint, consider etc' yeh aise verb hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'as' ka use comparison ke liye hota hai, lekin inn verbs se ek hi person ke baare mein kuch bataya jaata hai, jiska structure 'verb + object(person) + object complement', waise he sentence mein 'consider' verb hai 'her' object hai aur 'the primary candidate' object complement. Isliye yahan 'as' ka use nahi hoga. Note:- agar yeh verb 'passive voice mein use ho toh 'as' laga bhi sakte hai aur nahi bhi.

questions.question: While the scientists were performing the delicate experiment, (a)/ they clearly felt (b)/ a distinct ringing sound coming from the high-frequency magnetron placed nearby. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'felt' with 'heard'. Sentence mein 'felt' ki jagah 'heard' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'ringing sound ki awaaz aa rahi hai high frequency magnetron se' likha hai, toh koi bhi 'sound, awaaz' wagera sunai degi naa ki 'feel' hogi, isliye yahan 'heard' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: During the quarterly financial review, the CEO warned that (a)/ their biggest competitor would take over (b)/ them in terms of global market share by the end of the year. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'take over' with 'over take'. 'take over' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi cheez pe control paa lena' eg. 'the military take over of the government' aur 'over take' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi dusre vyakti, vehicle ko peche chhod dena kyunki aap fast chal rahe ho', sentence ka matlab hai 'jo unka biggest competitor hai global markets ke terms mein iss saal aage nikal jaayega', toh 'aage nikal jaane' waale meaning ke liye 'over take' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The ostensibly transparent mechanism (a)/ for employee feedback (b)/ paradoxically obfuscating (c)/ all channels of genuine expression. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'obfuscating' with 'obfuscates/ is obfuscating'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'dikhaawe ka transparent mechanism hai employee feedback ko bharne ka yeh paradoxically rokta hai saare genuine expression ke channels ko', sentence mein action 'obfuscating' se aa raha hai, matlab yehi verb hai aur 'ing' form bina helping verb ke nahi aati, toh agar meaning dena hai 'rukawat paida karta hai', toh yahan isse present indefinite 'obfuscates' likhenge, verb singular aayegi kyunki 'mechanism' subject hai. aur 'rukaawat paida kar raha hai' continuity wala meaning chahiye toh 'is obfuscating' present continuous ka use hoga.

questions.question: Had he been knowing (a)/ about the regulatory changes (b)/ he would not have proceeded (c)/ with the merger deal. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'been knowing' with 'known'. Sentence mein 'been knowing' ki jagah 'known' aayega kyunki 'know' ek stative verb hoti hai matlab jiske 'ing' form nahi hoti. Agar tense 'continuous' hota hai 'indefinite' ki taraf chale jaate hai aur 'perfect continuous' hota hai toh 'perfect' ki taraf chale jaate hai, isliye yahan 'been knowing' ki jagah pe 'known' karna padega. Note:- yeh conditional chapter ka structure hai 'if he had known = had he known'.

questions.question: He made a quick shower before heading to the office.
questions.solution: replace 'made' with 'took'. Sentence mein 'made' ki jagah 'took' aayega jaise 'koi joke sunaaye' toh 'tell' nahi balki 'crack a joke' bolte hai. jaise 'kisi ne galti kari' toh 'did a mistake' nahi 'made a mistake' bolte hai, waise he sentence ka matlab hai 'usne shower liya', toh iss meaning ke 'he took a shower' bolenge. Yeh phrase reading se ayenge.

questions.question: The teacher advised to listen attentively.
questions.solution: replace 'to listen' with 'listening'. 'advised' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai jiska structure 'advise somebody to do something' hota hai, toh yahan 'advised' ke baad object aaye jaise 'us, student etc' likh sakte hai, lekin 'advised' aur 'to listen' dono alag part mein hai, toh yeh pata nahi chal raha ki error kahan mark kare, isliye yeh nahi ho paayega. Lekin ek tarika aur hai ki 'advise' verb ke baad direct 'gerund' likhde 'advised listening attentively', toh direct baad gerund likhna bhi sahi hota hai. yeh dono structure sahi hote hai.

questions.question: She does not know to swim.
questions.solution: replace 'know to swim' with 'know how to swim'. Sentence mein 'know to swim' ki jagah 'know how to swim' aayega kyunki jab 'know, learn, practice etc' verb ke baad agar action likha ho toh inn verb aur action ke beech mein adverb ka use hota hai sahi meaning convey karne ke liye ki wo action kaise kiya jata hai, sentence ka sahi matlab hoga 'wo nahi jaanti ki swim kaise karte hai', isliye yahan 'she does not know how to swim' sahi hoga. eg. 'he does not know how/when to talk, he does not know what to say'.

questions.question: The children swinged happily (a)/ on the old tire hung from the tree (b)/ and laughed loudly (c)/ as the sun set in the evening.(d)
questions.solution: replace 'swinged' with 'swung'. 'swing' verb hoti hai jiski form 'swing, swung, swung' hoti hai, past ka sentence hai isliye 'swing' ki 2nd form 'swung' aayegi.

questions.question: The magistrate asked the accused what was he doing with his hand in the gentleman's pocket.
questions.solution: replace 'was he' with 'he was'. Yeh sentence indirect speech mein likha hai aur indirect mein assertive mein likha hota hai jisme 'verb' subject ke baad aati hai, 'verb' subject se pehle interrogative, inversion sentence mein aati hai, lekin yeh interrogative nahi hai, isliye yahan 'he was' subject ke baad verb aayegi.

questions.question: The heavy rainfall and sudden drop in temperature (a)/ could effect not only (b)/ the crop yields but also the transportation of goods. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'effect' with 'affect'. Sentence mein 'effect' ki jagah 'affect' aayega kyunki 'affect' verb hoti hai aur 'effect' noun hota hai, sentene mein 'could' ke baad verb ki base form ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'affect' verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: While I was preparing for my presentation in the library, (a)/ I suddenly listened to (b)/ a loud, unexpected crash from the upper floor. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'listened to' with 'heard'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jab wo library mein presentation bana rahi thi, tabhi achanak upper floor se tez crash hone ki awaz sunai di', agar 'intentionally' sunte ho toh 'listen' ka use hota hai, lekin 'kuch sunai de jaaye' toh 'hear' ka use hota hai, matlab se pata chal raha ki 'awaaz' sunai di, matlab intentionally nahi suni, isliye yahan 'heard' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The students who were prepared (a)/ the presentation on sustainable energy (b)/ were praised by the principal during the assembly. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'were' before 'prepared'. Sentence mein 'the students who were prepared' se matlab hoga 'students jinhe prepare kiya gaya tha', lekin sentence ka matlab dena hai 'students jinhone prepare kari thi presentation', toh 'students' prepare karne ke doer hai, isliye 'were prepared' passive mein nahi balki 'prepared' active mein likhenge, jisse sahi matlab aayega, isliye yahan 'prepared' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Before the guests arrived for the evening party, (a)/ the homeowner carefully hanged (b)/ all the new curtains in the drawing room. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'hanged' with 'hung'. 'hanged' ki jagah 'hung' aayega kyunki jab matlab 'latkaane wala dena' hota hai, toh 'hang, hung, hung' form chalti hai aur jab 'faansi pe latkaane' wala meaning chahiye, toh 'hang, hanged, hanged' form chalti hai, sentence mein 'curtains' latkaane ki baat karni hai, isliye yahan 'hung' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi.

questions.question: While the tourist was walking through the dense jungle, (a)/ he suddenly wandered (b)/ how he would find his way back to the camp before sunset. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'wandered' with 'wondered'. 'wandered' ki jagah 'wondered' aayega kyunki 'wander' ka matlab 'idhar udhar ghumna' aur 'wonder' ka matlab 'sochna, kuch jaanna chahna', sentence ka matlab hai 'tourist jab ghane jungle se jaa rahe the, tabhi usne socha ki wapas camp jaane ke liye raasta kaise find karenge', toh sentence mein 'sochne' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'wondered' verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: The reporter had to ask several probing questions (a)/ in order to illicit (b)/ a confession from the corrupt official about his hidden assets. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'illicit' with 'elicit'. 'illicit' ki jagah 'elicit' aayega kyunk 'elicit' ka matlab 'kisi se koi information nikalwaana' aur 'illicit' ka matlab 'illegal', sentence ka matlab hai 'reporter ne bahut question kare usse confession ugalwaane ke liye', toh 'information nikalwaane' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'elicit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: When the temperature dropped suddenly, the water (a)/ got freeze inside the pipes and (b)/caused them to burst, which (c)/resulted in heavy damage to the building.(d)
questions.solution: replace 'freeze' with 'frozen'. Sentence mein 'got' linking verb hai aur linking verb ke baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, 'freeze' toh verb hoti hai, isliye yahan iski third form 'frozen' past participle ke roop mein adjective kaa kaam karegi, isliye yahan 'got frozen' sahi hoga. Eg. 'he got tired, he got injured'.

questions.question: The traffic signal on the main highway intersection (a)/ suddenly malfunctioned last evening, and several collisions were occurred (b)/ within a span of just fifteen minutes. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'were' before 'occurred'. 'occurred' se pehle 'were' nahi aayega kyunki 'occur' apne aap mein happening verb hoti hai jiska matlab hee hota hai 'hona', isliye isse passive mein use nahi karte, isliye yahan simple past tense 'occurred' ka use hoga.

questions.question: During the sudden thunderstorm, the villagers fleed to higher ground to avoid the rapidly rising water and waited anxiously until the rain stopped.
options: to avoid the rapidly rising water
questions.solution: replace 'fleed' with 'fled'. 'flee' verb hoti hai jiski form chalti hai 'flee, fled, fled', sentence mein past ki baat karni hai, isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form 'fled' sahi hoga. 'fleed' jaise koi word nahi hota.

questions.question: I trust him a lot because he (a)/ has always and will (b)/ support me in future too(c)/. No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'has always and will' with 'has always supported and will support'. Sentence mein 'and' conjunction se 'has' aur 'will' helping verb ko joda hai, do helping verb ke liye ek main verb se kaam chala sakte hai, lekin 'has' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai aur 'will' ke baad base form, isliye yahan 'has' ke sath verb ki 3rd form 'supported' ka use karna padega, isliye 'has always supported and will support' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The captain carefully examined (a) / the sunk ship (b) / at the bottom of the bay, hoping to recover some valuables. (c) / No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'sunk' with 'sunken'. Sentence mein 'ship' subject hai aur isse pehle adjective ki jarurat hai, lekin 'sunk' toh verb hoti hai, 'sink' verb ki form 'sink, sank, sunk' hoti hai aur adjective past participle 'sunken' hota hai, isliye yahan 'sunken ship' sahi hoga.

questions.question: During the storm, the river overflew (a) / its banks and flooded (b) / several nearby villages, causing exensive damage. (c) / No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'overflew' with 'overflowed'. 'overflow' verb hoti hai jiski form 'overflow, overflowed, overflowed' hoti hai, kyunki sentence mein past ke action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'overflowed' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi. 'overflew' word he galat hai.

questions.question: She asked to him (a) / to explain the procedure clearly (b) / before starting the experiment. (c) / No error(d)
questions.solution: remove 'to' after 'asked'.
