Sentence mein 'asked' ke baad 'to' nahi aayega kyunki 'asked' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai jisme indirect object 'him' hai aur direct object 'to explain' hai. toh 'ask, advice, order' yeh di-transitive verb ke baad agar human being likhte ho toh indirect object ke sath preposition ka use nahi hota, isliye yahan 'asked him to explain' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The mechanic warned the driver that the front right wheel of the truck was very lose and needed immediate tightening to prevent an accident.
questions.solution: 'lose' ek verb hoti hai jiski form 'lose, lost, lost' hoti hai, lekin sentence mein 'was' linking verb hai aur inke sath subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, 'loose' adjective hota hai jiska matlab 'dheela' hota hai, toh sentence ke meaning aur grammar ke according 'very loose' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The lionesses, after a long and exhausting chase across the savanna, usually prey on the slowest member of the herd to conserve their energy.
questions.solution: 'pray' ka matlab 'prathna karna, prayer karna', aur 'prey' ka matlab 'sikaar', 'praise' ka matlab 'tareef karna', sentence mein 'lionesses' plural noun hai jiske liye plural verb aayegi, 'prey' plural verb hai aur 'preys' singular. Isliye yahan 'no substitution' hoga.

questions.question: The main speech of the political leader at the massive rally were telecasted live on all major news channels last night.
questions.solution: Kuch verb jaise 'wed, cost, set, bet, bid, thrust, telecast, forecast, overcast, broadcast etc.' yeh kuch aise verb hai jinki 'v1,v2, v3' form same hoti hai, isliye yahan 'telecast' aayega aur 'main speech' singular subject hai, isliye yahan singular verb 'was telecast' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Dr. Harris welcomed the members of the committee and went on ____ the subject of the meeting.
questions.solution: sentence ke meaning ke according 'to introduce' sahi hoga jisse sentence ka matlab hoga 'Dr. Harris ne committee members ka welcome kiya aur meeting ke subject ko introduce kiya', isliye yahan 'to introduce' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The chief guest stepped onto the stage and began waiving vigorously to the huge crowd gathered at the convention center.
questions.solution: 'waive' verb hoti hai jiska matlab 'chhod dena, tyag dena' hota hai. Aur 'wave' ka matlab 'haath hilana', sentence mein 'haath hilaane' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'waving' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The intern should take a right choice in choosing the right job for her.
questions.solution: Jaise 'bathing' ke 'made a shower' nahi 'took a shower' bolte hai, joke sunane ko 'tell a joke' nahi 'crack a joke' bolte hai waise he sahi decision lene ke liye 'make a right choice' phrase ka use karte hai, yeh kuch fix phrase hai jo reading se hee ayenge.

questions.question: The teacher described about the historical events of the revolution in detail during the lecture.
questions.solution: 'describe' ek transitive verb hoti hai jiske baad verb ko object chahiye hota hai, agar preposition likh denge toh wo object preposition ka object ban jaayega, isliye yahan 'described the historical events' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The businessman is owning multiple companies across Asia, and he is believing that his investments will continue to grow despite the market fluctuations.
questions.solution: 'own, believe, think, consider, possess, look, seem, appear, consist, contain, comprise, feel, smell, taste etc' yeh stative verbs hoti hai inki 'ing' form nahi hoti, sentence mein kahi gayi baat ek fact ke tarah hai jaise 'businessman ke pass multiple companies hai, aur wo manta hai uski investment humesha badhegi', isliye inhe present indefinite mein likhenge, isliye 'owns, believes' option (a) sahi hoga.

questions.question: It is the responsibility of all of us to invest time and effort in verifying information and not follow victim to fake news.
questions.solution: 'fall victim to something' yeh ek phrase hota hai jiska matlab hota hai 'sikaar ban jana', sentence ka matlab hai 'information verify karein aur sikaar naa ban jaaye fake news ka', toh sentence ke meaning ke accoding 'not fall victim' option D sahi hoga. yeh kuch phrases hote hai jo reading se hee ayenge.

questions.question: The art history teacher was sacked after she were thought taking school supplies.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'preparing' subject(noun(gerund)) hai, 'children' object of gerund, 'for' preposition aur 'uncertainties' object of preposition, aur 'keep' verb hai, toh verb singular, plural subject ke according aati hai, kyunki 'gerund' ka plural nahi hota, isliya yahan singular verb 'keeps' aayegi, isliye option B aur D galat honge. 'for readiness' se meaning hoga 'readiness ke liye', balki meaning dena hai 'readiness mein rakhta hai challenge face karne ke liye', matlab 'ready rakhta hai', isliye yahan 'keeps them in readiness' hee sahi hoga, isliye 'no improvement' hoga. Note:- agar 'keeps them ready' option hota toh wo best hota.

questions.question: Despite her busy schedule, she _____ to complete all the household chores and _____ for the cleaning service to come in the following week.
questions.solution: 'insure' ka matlab 'insurance', sentence mein insurance jaise koi baat nahi karni, isliye option A aur B galat honge, sentence mein 'she' subject ke baad 'verb' chahiye aur verb ke baad 'to complete' infinitive likha hai, aur next 'dash' mein bhi infinitive aayega kyunki 'and' conjunction se do infinitive ko jod rahe hai, agar 'and' conjunction se do infinitive jodte hai, toh baad wala infinitive bare form mein aata hai. Khud kuch kaam kare toh 'arrange' verb hai, lekin jab yeh kehna ki yeh 'arrange' kara dunga toh 'arrange for' phrasal verb ka use hota hai, sentence mein likha ki 'cleaning service aayegi agle hafte, matlab usse 'arrange karwa di', isliye 2nd dash mein 'arrange' aayega, isliye 'managed, arrange' sahi hoga. Sentence ka matlab hoga 'usne ghar ke saare kaam poore kar diya, aur agle hafte ke liye arrange kar diya'.

questions.question: You __________ take a break if you feel tired; working continuously is harmful to your health.
questions.solution: Option C galat hoga kyunki 'have' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aayegi. Option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'need' jab main verb hota hai, toh iske baad infinitive aata hai, 'you need to take' hota. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'might' se meaning aayega 'tum le sakte hai', lekin sentence mein 'chahiye' wala meaning chahiye, sentence ka matlab hoga 'agar tum tired feel kar rahe ho toh tumhe break lena chahiye', toh 'chahiye' waale meaning ke liye 'ought to' option A sahi hoga. Note:- 'ought to' waise toh moral cheezon ke liye se hota hai, lekin 'chahiye' waale meaning ke liye bhi use hota hai.

questions.question: He realized that his reckless driving (a)/ should have been (b)/ the cause of that serious accident. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'should have been' with 'could have been'. Model verb ke error jyadatar meaning based hote hai. Sentence mein 'reckless driving should have been' se matlab hoga 'reckless driving kaaran hona chahiye tha', toh 'chahiye' wala meaning galat hai, sentence ka matlab hona chahiye 'reckless driving kaaran ho sakti thi serious accident ka', toh 'ho sakti thi' waale meaning ke liye 'could have been' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Even if the heavy fog continues all through the night, (a)/ the rescue team will ready (b)/ to begin the search operation early in the morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'will ready' with 'will be ready'. 'will' model hai 'ready' adjective hai, 'ready' verb bhi hota jab iska maltab 'kisi aur ko taiyaar karna' hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'prepared (taiyaar rehne)' wala meaning nahi chahiye, toh 'will' model ke baad 'be' linking verb ka use hoga jisse 'ready' subject complement banega 'be' linking verb ke liye, isliye yahan 'will be ready' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She said that she can finish (a) / the project before the deadline (b) / if she got enough support from her team. (c) / No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'can' with 'could'. Sentence mein 'said' aur 'got' se pata chal raha ki sentence past mein hai, isliye 'can' verb ki past form 'could' likhna padega.

questions.question: After we receive the advanced payment for the consignment, (a)/ the client need not to worry (b)/ about any further financial formalities until the final delivery. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'need not to worry' with 'need not worry'. 'need, dare' ke baad agar 'not' laga hota hai, toh 'need, dare' model ban jaate hai, aur model ke baad verb ki base form ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye yahan 'to worry' infinitive nahi 'worry' verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: This retired couple has now become (a) used to walk (b)/ ten kilometers every morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to walk' with 'to walking'. Sentence mein 'couple' subject hai, 'has' helping verb hai 'become' 3rd form main verb (linking verb) hai, aur 'used' adjective hai subject complement hai linking verb ke liye, 'to' preposition hai aur preposition ke baad preposition ke object chahiye hota hai, lekin 'walk' toh verb hoti hai, isliye isse 'walking' gerund mein change karna padega jisse yeh object banega 'to' preposition ka, isliye yahan 'to walking' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I will inform you immediately should (a) he arrives late for the meeting (b) tomorrow morning. (c) No error(d)
questions.solution: replace 'arrives' with 'arrive'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'mein tumhe haal inform kar dunga agar wo kal subah meeting mein late aaya', yahan 'should' mein koi dikkat nahi hai kyunki 'should' ko kind of conjunction jaisa bhi use mein le lete hai condition baatane ke liye, isliye yahan 'should' galat nahi hai, balki 'arrives' ki jagah 'arrive' aayega kyunki 'model' ke baad verb ki base form aati hai. Eg. 'should you need any help = if you need any help'.

questions.question: During my college days in Bangalore, (a)/ I used to woke up (b)/ very early to catch the first bus to the university campus every single morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'woke up' with 'wake up'. Sentence mein past ki habit ki baat ho rahi hai, aur past ke habit ke liye 'used to' model ka use hota hai, toh yahan 'used to' model hai aur model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'woke up' past tense nahi balki 'wake up' base form mein use hoga.

questions.question: Even with all the evidence against Roshan, (a)/ no one dare believe (b)/ that he could commit such a heinous crime. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'dare believe' with 'dares to believe'. Sentence mein 'no one' singular subject hai aur 'dare' main verb hai aur iske baad ek aur verb 'believe' galat hai, aur jab 'dare' main verb hota hai toh iske baad infinitive aata hai, isliye yahan 'to believe' hoga, aur singular subject ke according singular verb 'dares' ka use hoga, isliye 'dares to believe' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Whenever the weather changes suddenly, (a)/ the old gardener uses to complain (b)/ about severe pain in his knee joints. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'use to complain' with 'complains'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jab bhi mausam achaanak change hota hai, toh boodha gardener ghutne ke dard ki complain karta hai', toh sentence mein present ke habitual action ke baat karni hai, jiske liye present indefinite tense ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'use to' nahi aayega aur gardener ke according singular verb 'complains' aayegi.

questions.question: If the security guard had not arrived on time, (a)/ the thieves might stole (b)/ all the valuables from the safe last night. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'might stole' with 'might have stolen'. Sentence mein 'if + (had + v3) + (would/could/might + have + v3)' follow ho raha hai, jiske according 'might have stolen' ka use hoga, sentence ka matlab hai 'agar security guard time pe nahi aaya hota, toh thieve ne chori kar liye hote valuables', toh 'chori nahi kari' balki meaning dena hai 'chori kar liye hote', toh sahi meaning ke liye 'might have stolen' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I never expected that Rohan, my best friend would (a)/ leave me in the lurch like this and (b)/ then do not even apologise.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'do'. Sentence mein 'would' helping verb hai aur 'leave' main verb aur 'do' helping verb aur 'apologise' main verb hai, toh sentence mein 'and' conjunction se do verb jod rahe hai, kyunki 'do not even apologise' ke sath subject dubara nahi likha toh helping verb bhi dubara nahi aayegi, isliye dusri verb ke sath 'do' helping verb nahi aayegi, aur 'would' helping verb dono main verb ke liye understood ho jaayegi, isliye yahan 'do' nahi aayega.

questions.question: When I was a child, I would play (a) / in the fields every evening (b) / with my friends. (c) / No error (d)
questions.solution: 'no error'. Sentence mein past ki habit baatayi jaa rahi, aur past ki habit batane ke liye 'used to' yaa 'would' model ka use karte hai, isliye yeh sentence no error hai.

questions.question: Riya should go (a) / to the doctor earlier / when she noticed the persistent cough, / but she ignored it for weeks. (b) / No error(c)
questions.solution: replace 'should go' with 'should have gone'. Sentence mein 'Riya should go' se matlab hoga 'Riya ko jaana chahiye', lekin matlab dena hai 'Riya ko doctor ke pass pehle chale jaana chahiye tha jab usne cough ko notice kiya aur ignore karti rahi hafton tak', toh jab koi kaam jo pehle ho chukka aur uska ulta imagine karna ho toh 'should/could/might + have + v3' structure follow hota hai, toh 'chale jaana chahiye tha' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'should have gone' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Despite the recent increase in funding, the local community center still needs collect more resources to run its adult literacy program effectively throughout the year.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'need' aur 'collect' do verb sath mein galat hai aur generally 'need' ke sath infinitive ka use hota hai, 'centre' subject hai jiske sath singular verb aayegi, isliye yahan 'needs to collect' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: I assure you that the developers can be able to complete the coding module within the next two working days without fail.
questions.solution: 'can' aur 'able to' sath mein galat hote hai kyunki dono 'ability' ko dikhate hai, sentence ke meaning ke according future bhi dikhaana aur ability bhi dikhaani hai, lekin 'can' future nahi dikhaata, isliye yahan 'will be able to complete' sahi option hoga. Baaki options mein 'can' ke sath 'able to' likha hai.
